video_title: Huge Announcement! + Big Mitchell Extension For Cavs & Brad Stevens Talks Brown Trade

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Bontemps announces he is joining the Atlanta Hawks front office
quotes.excerpt: I am, I am unfortunately not going to be on the pod anymore, which people figured out

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What do we have here? We can't say where he is because he is now an official member of a team and all information is secret. We would like to welcome from the Atlanta Hawks, Tim Bontemps.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Hello everybody. It's nice to be back. I am, I am unfortunately not going to be on the pod anymore, which people figured out over the last couple weeks, because I am joining the Atlanta Hawks.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Bontemps discusses his new role as strategic advisor for the Atlanta Hawks
quotes.excerpt: I will be a strategic advisor to Landry Fields, who between he and the Ressler family

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Do you want to explain to the folks what exactly you will be doing with the Hawks, or at least give your company man, I mean, first off, let me just say, why are you, are you dumping us? What's going on here? You got all this swag on, all this gear. Is that free gear?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I don't know if I'm dumping you is the right word, but I am, I am unfortunately not going to be on the pod anymore, which people figured out over the last couple weeks, because I am joining the Atlanta Hawks. That is my title. I will be a strategic advisor to Landry Fields, who between he and the Ressler family, I am very appreciative of them giving me a chance to try something new.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon reveals he has landed a consulting gig with the Atlanta Hawks
quotes.excerpt: I did land a consulting gig with the Atlanta Hawks. So Bontemps and I are still teammates.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Listen, I have an announcement to make. I am still Team ESPN, don't you worry. However, I haven't cleared this with our bosses yet, but I did land a consulting gig with the Atlanta Hawks. So Bontemps and I are still teammates. I'm out here, I'm losing around as you do at Summer League, and I'm chatting up Quin Snyder, I'm chatting up Quinn Snyder, and you know, I did inform them that nobody in the world is better at telling Bontemps to shut the bleep up than me.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst and Tim MacMahon discuss Donovan Mitchell's contract extension with the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: Donovan Mitchell is now signed two extensions and basically cementing that the Cavs investment in the draft assets

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Now we got that piece of business out of the way, MacMahon, we can get down to real talk here. I think it's only appropriate we follow up here with Cavs Corner. So, in, what do you think his report to the Hawks is about Donovan Mitchell signing a four-year, $270 million contract extension with the Cavs on the first day he's eligible on Tuesday?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Oh, this is a gong show. You know, look, it's a tough spot for the Cavs, honestly, because Donovan Mitchell is the face of your franchise. He's an All-NBA player. In one sense, him committing to you for four years is a major win. But we just saw how rough the market was for Jaylen Brown in large part because of how much salary he made. And, you know, I'm looking for one of the quotes that a GM gave me, but essentially, it was, and look, the analytics are more friendly to Donovan, he's not as good a defensive player, but, you know, one of the GMs basically said, like, in terms of this kind of money, you've got to be a generational talent. And this guy didn't think Jaylen Brown was close to that, but he essentially said, you know, when you get into like the $70 million range, which is obviously where this is, there might only be a couple of players in the league that are worth that kind of money. And so, there is some major risk involved here, especially when you've got Evan Mobley making 50 plus a year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens and Bill Chism's disciplined media availability
quotes.excerpt: Brad doesn't speak to the media very often and when he does, he's very disciplined.
quotes.quote: Before we move on, I do think we should talk about Brad Stevens having a press conference with Bill Chism, the Celtics governor. That happened on Monday afternoon. Brad doesn't speak to the media very often and when he does speak to the media, he's very disciplined and very matter-of-fact. It's the way he has always been, and I think for a situation like this, it's sort of perfect because he's not going to come out and be fiery. He's not going to be Pat Riley. He's going to come out and have his set of talking points and stick to them. They sat there and took question after question after question. They let the media come and ask everything. They only ended the press conference when they were answering the same question again and again.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Skepticism regarding the Celtics' explanation of the Jaylen Brown situation
quotes.excerpt: They were full of crap when they acted like the relationship with Jaylen Brown didn't deteriorate.
quotes.quote: They were a little bit full of crap if we want to be blunt and direct here. And they were full of crap when they acted like the relationship with Jaylen Brown didn't deteriorate and wasn't a factor in this decision. It was a driving force in the decision. You can't tell me both that money didn't matter and it wasn't about any of that stuff. Now, I believe the money part because you didn't really save money right away on this deal. And by the way, this deal ultimately is going to be judged by what are you able to flip Paul George's expiring contract next year plus a bunch of picks into.
